name: Wildcat Resources Limited
summary: Wildcat Resources Limited operates as a mineral exploration and development company in Australia. It primarily explores gold, lithium, copper, and tantalum deposits. The company's holds interest in the Tabba Tabba Lithium and tantalum development project located in Western Australia; Mt Adrah Project in the Lachlan Fold Belt in New South Wale; and Bolt Cutter Central Lithium Project located in the Pilbara region of Western Australia. The company was formerly known as Fraser Range Metals Group Limited and changed its name to Wildcat Resources Limited in July 2020. Wildcat Resources Limited was incorporated in 2001 and is based in West Perth, Australia.
